_comment: Read by templates/session-start-hook.sh (step 2e) and merged into ~/.claude/settings.json: claude.ai connectors no project uses, blocked so their tool names stay out of every session's context. Each connector is listed under its plain name (cloud sessions) and its 'claude.ai <name>' form (local CLI). To use one again, remove it here and from ~/.claude/settings.json deniedMcpServers. Kept on purpose: github, Context7, Firecrawl, Figma, Claude_Docs, Supabase, Sentry, Notion. Names with spaces or dots are listed also as the tool prefix spells them (underscores): in a 2026-11-11 session the plain one-word names (Gmail, Postman, eDreams) disconnected, the others did not.
